description: Rodinia backprop: one complete input -> 16 -> 1 hybrid training epoch. Original tiled GPU forward and weight/momentum update are connected by CPU partial-sum reduction, activations, output/hidden deltas and output-weight update. Only the two GPU kernels contribute to the summed event time; required host stages/transfers are excluded.

scaling_param.name: input
scaling_param.description: Input layer size (number of input neurons). Must be a multiple of 16; one 16-row block per 16 input units. The original standard run uses 65536.

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Optional clock/cache warmer after initial uploads and immediately before the first GPU forward kernel. No reconditioning before the dependent weight update; intervening original hybrid stages can change cache/clock state.
